is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles arabiensis.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (1014F) and Vgsc L995S (1014S).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides sample sizes (N) and allele frequencies for Vgsc-1014S and Vgsc-1014F for both species across multiple years and districts.

african_field_population.evidence: The study collected mosquitoes from four malaria-endemic districts in western Kenya.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data on kdr mutations.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies four districts in western Kenya: Bondo, Nyando, Rachuonyo, and Teso.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports collections performed annually between 2011 and 2013.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports new field collections and genotyping results for 2011-2013.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including sample sizes and frequencies, are provided in Table 1.

assessment.summary: This study reports the first detection of the Vgsc-1014F (kdr-west) mutation in Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles arabiensis in western Kenya, based on field collections from 2011 to 2013 across four districts.
